news.title: U.S. votes in midterm elections with control of Congress at stake
news.summary: Americans vote Tuesday for all 435 House seats and 35 of 100 Senate seats. Republicans currently hold narrow majorities in both chambers; results are expected from Tuesday night into Wednesday.

news.title: U.S. strikes Iran's Qeshm Island as Tehran offers to reopen Hormuz
news.summary: A U.S. official called the strikes defensive, aimed at Iranian surface-to-air missile sites; Iranian media reported five explosions. Hours earlier Iran said it could reopen the Strait of Hormuz within two days if Washington meets its conditions.

news.title: Russia launches 289 drones and 17 missiles at Ukraine after truce
news.summary: Overnight strikes hit energy sites and Odesa-region ports, a day after a bombing in Zaporizhzhia region killed at least 29. U.S.-mediated Russia-Ukraine talks are set for Nov. 10-11 in Abu Dhabi.

news.title: Anthropic S-1 update shows $17B Q3 revenue ahead of IPO roadshow
news.summary: Amended filing shows nine-month revenue of $33.2 billion, up about 1,200%, and a $104 billion net loss driven mostly by convertible-note accounting. It lists about $895 billion in compute and infrastructure commitments.

news.title: Ebola outbreak death toll passes 5,300, fastest-growing on record
news.summary: Africa CDC says 5,376 people have died, almost all in DR Congo, which has more than 10,000 infections. Cases have also appeared in Kenya, Uganda and Nigeria; the Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine.

news.title: S&P 500 slips 0.5% as chip stocks slide; Dow edges up
news.summary: On Monday the S&P 500 fell about 0.5% and the Nasdaq 100 lost 1.4% to a three-month low as semiconductor stocks dropped over 3%. The Dow rose 0.4%, and oil fell more than 7% on Iran diplomacy hopes.

news.title: Carney heads to Commonwealth summit with King Charles in Antigua
news.summary: The prime minister is spending one day at the Commonwealth leaders' meeting, focused on trade and investment. Canada does about $100 billion in trade with Commonwealth countries as Ottawa looks to diversify away from the U.S.

news.title: Belgian PM De Wever offers resignation after budget talks collapse
news.summary: The coalition could not agree on how to find €10 billion in savings to meet EU deficit rules. King Philippe is weighing the offer and consulting party leaders; new elections are possible.

news.title: Apple beats estimates as iPhone revenue jumps 17.5%
news.summary: Quarterly revenue rose 12% to $114.5 billion and EPS hit $2.10. Shares fell about 3% after hours on margin guidance hurt by higher memory chip costs.

news.title: B.C. First Nations challenge Pacific Link pipeline designation
news.summary: Nine First Nations filed legal challenges to Ottawa naming the Alberta-to-B.C. oil pipeline a national-interest project, citing inadequate consultation and salmon risks. The project is estimated at $35-43 billion.

news.title: Anthropic says it may soon hit its self-improving AI threshold
news.summary: The S-1/A says Anthropic may imminently meet its policy definition of dramatically AI-accelerated progress, though no current model is designated as exceeding it. It says it won't let AI design frontier models without human oversight.

news.title: Marvell to buy Lumentum in $115 billion all-stock AI deal
news.summary: Lumentum holders get 4.5 Marvell shares each, implying a $115 billion enterprise value; closing is expected in the first half of 2028. Marvell fell about 13% and Lumentum nearly 19% on the news.

news.title: North Korea rejects FBI blame for $6B Binance hack, tests missiles
news.summary: The FBI tied a North Korea-linked group to the roughly $6 billion Binance theft, possibly the largest crypto heist on record. Pyongyang called it a provocation and test-fired cruise missiles with a new cluster warhead.

news.title: New York records first measles death in over 30 years
news.summary: A child died in rural Lewis County, the fourth U.S. measles death this year. The CDC counts 4,666 confirmed cases in 2026, about double last year.

news.title: OpenAI hires former Army Secretary Dan Driscoll for national security
news.summary: Driscoll becomes senior counselor for national security modernization, advising on AI in defence and cybersecurity and helping U.S. allies adopt AI.

news.title: N.B.'s Campobello Island caught in middle of Canada-U.S. trade war
news.summary: The island of about 900 people is reachable by road only through Maine. Residents faced 25% tariffs on U.S. goods until Ottawa granted an exemption, and a local brewery has closed.

news.title: OpenAI merges ChatGPT's Chat and Work tabs in desktop app
news.summary: The combined experience rolls out first to select users. Codex stays separate but shares the same usage pool with ChatGPT.

news.title: Canada's first trial of alleged ISIS woman hinges on texts to mother
news.summary: Ammara Amjad, 32, is on trial in Brampton for allegedly taking part in a terrorist group. The Crown relies on about 10,000 messages she sent from Syria; the defence disputes the translations.
